verses.text: Aya ni amajambo yahawe Amosi, umwungere w’i Tekowa i Buyuda. Ayo majambo yayaronse mu vyo yeretswe imyaka ibiri imbere y’uko haba nyamugigima, hakaba hari ku ngoma ya Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda, n’iya Yerobowamu mwene Yowashi umwami wa Isirayeli.
Yavuze ati: “ Uhoraho yivuze ari i Siyoni aturagara ari i Yerusalemu; uburagiro bw’abungere buruma, kandi ku gatwe ka Karumeli harakabirana.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Damasiko, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko basekuje abantu banje b’i Gileyadi imihini y’ivyuma.
Nzorungika umuriro ku nzu ya Hazayeli kandi uzotongora impome zikomeye za Beni-Hadadi.
Nzohomvorera hasi amarembo y’i Damasiko; nzokwica umwami ari mu kiyaya ca Aveni n’uwufise inkoni yo kuganza ari i Beti-Edeni. Abantu b’i Siriya bazojanwa ari inyagano i Kiru,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vy’i Gaza, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Ko bafashe abantu bo mu mihana yose bakabagira imbohe maze bakabagurisha kuri Edomu;
nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Gaza utongore impome zikomeye zaho.

Nzorandura umwami w’i Ashidodi n’uwufise inkoni yo kuganza w’i Ashikeloni. Nzohindukiza ukuboko kwanje ngwanye Ekuroni, gushika uwa nyuma wo mu Bafilisitiya apfuye,” uko ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Tiro, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bafashe abantu bo mu mihana yose bakabagira imbohe bakabagurisha ku Banyedomu, ntibubahiriza isezerano ry’uko ari abavukanyi.
Ku bw’ivyo nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Tiro, utongore impome zaho zikomeye.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Edomu, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye. Ko yakinagije umuvukanyi wiwe Isirayeli n’inkota agasogota abagore bo mu gihugu, kandi uburake bwiwe bukaziriringa urudaca, ubushangashirwe bwiwe bukarurumba ntibuhwame;
nzorungika umuriro i Temani utongore impome zikomeye z’i Bozira.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Amoni, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bafomoye inda z’abagore bibungenze b’i Gileyadi kugira ngo bagure imbibe zabo.
Nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Raba utongore impome zikomeye zaho mu gihe hazoba hari akamo k’intambara, intambara imeze nk’umuyaga w’igihuhusi.
Umwami waho azojanwa ari inyagano, we hamwe n’abaganwa biwe bose,” uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

headings.text: Imanza zizocirwa ibihugu bibanyi vya Isirayeli

verses.text: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Mowabu, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Ko batongoje umuriro bagahindura umunyota amagufa y’umwami w’i Edomu,
nzorungika umuriro kuri Mowabu uzotongora impome zikomeye z’i Keriyoti. Abanyamowabu bazohindikirana bicwe n’igihumura, kubera urwamo rw’intambara no kuvuza inzamba.
Nzorandura umwami waho, kandi nzomwicana n’abaganwa baho,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Yuda, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bateye ibitugu ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ntibitondera ivyo yihanikirije, bazimizwa n’imana z’ibinyoma, izo ba sekuruza bakurikiye.
Ni co gituma nzorungika umuriro kuri Yuda uzotongora impome zikomeye z’i Yerusalemu.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Isirayeli, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Bagurisha uwutagira icaha ku giciro c’ifeza, n’umukene bakamugurisha umwambaro umwe w’ibirato.
Basiribanga umutwe w’umukene nk’uko basiribanga umukungugu bakarenganya urubanza rw’impahazwa. Umuhungu na se basangira umugore mu busambanyi bwabo bagatukisha izina ryanje ryera.
Baryama i ruhande y’igicaniro cose, bakisasira impuzu batse abakene kw’ingwati. Kandi mu nzu y’imana zabo, banywa umuvinyu batse abo baciriye imanza.

Ariko naranduye Abamori mu maso yabo, naho mu burebure bwabo bari bameze nk’ibiti vy’amasederi mu gukomera na ho bari bameze nk’ibiti vy’inganzamarumpu. Nahoneje ivyamwa vyari hejuru ku mashami ndandura n’imizi yabo mu kuzimu!
Nabaduganye ndabakura muri Egiputa ndabarongora imyaka mirongo ine mu bugaragwa ngo ndabahe igihugu c’Abamori.
Kandi nahagurukije abavugishwa nanje bo mu bana banyu n’Abanaziri mu misore yanyu. Mbega ivyo si ivy’ukuri, ga yemwe bantu ba Isirayeli?” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Ariko mwahatiye Abanaziri kunywa umuvinyu, mutegeka abavugishwa nanje kudakura ururimi mu kanwa.
None rero ngiye kubasiribanga nk’uko umukogote usiribanga isi iyo wiremetse ingano.
Uwuzi kwiruka cane ntibizomukiza, n’umunyenkomezi ntazokwikiza kubera inkomezi ziwe, kandi n’umuhizi mu ntambara ntazokwikiza.
Uwurasisha umuheto ntazoshobora guhagarara, uwunyaruka mu kwiruka ntazoshobora kwiruka ngo anyage amagara yiwe, kandi n’uwugendera kw’ifarasi ntazokwikiza.
Mbere, n’umuhizi mu ntambara, kuri uwo musi azohunga ata co yambaye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimwumve iri jambo, yemwe Bisirayeli, ijambo Uhoraho yavuze abagiriza, yagiriza umuryango wose yaduganye akuye muri Egiputa. Yavuze ati:
“Ni mwebwe mwenyene natoranije mu miryango yose yo mw’isi; ni co gituma nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu vyose.
Mbega babiri bojana batabanje kubisezerana?
Mbega intambwe yokwivugira mw’ishamba ata co yishe? Mbega yokwivugira mu kibundo cayo ata co yafashe?
Mbega inyoni yofatwa mu mutego ugaragara ata co kurya kirimwo ngo kiyikwege? Mbega umutego woshibuka ata co wafashe?
Iyo inzamba ivuze mu gisagara, mbega abantu ntibahinda agashitsi? Mbega icago coza ku gisagara, atari Uhoraho akirungitse?
Ni ukuri, Uhoraho Nyeninganji nta co akora atabanje kugihishurira abasavyi biwe b’abavugishwa.
Intambwe yivuze ni nde atotinya? Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, ni nde yokwanka kumenyesha ivyo avuze?
Nimumenyeshe abari mu bihome bikomeye vy’i Ashidodi n’abo mu ngoro zikomeye zo muri Egiputa muti: ‘Nimukoranire ku misozi y’i Samariya; mwirabire umuryano waho, n’agacinyizo kari mu bantu baho.’
Ntibazi gukora ivyiza,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “bujuje mu mazu yabo akomeye ivyo banyaze, n’ivyo bakuye mu bwicanyi.”
Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Umwansi azokwifatira igihugu canyu, asenyurire hasi iminara yawe anyage ibiri mu ngoro zawe vyose.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nk’uko umwungere agerageza kurokora intama mu kanwa k’intambwe akayaka amagufa y’amaguru gusa canke agace k’ugutwi, ni ko Abisirayeli baba i Samariya bazorokoka, bazokiza umutwe w’uburiri gusa n’igice c’impuzu bisasiye.
Nimwumve ibi kandi mubimenyeshe aba Yakobo,” ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, avuze.
“Ku musi nzohanirako Abisirayeli kubera ivyaha vyabo, nzosambura ibicaniro vy’i Beteli; amahembe y’igicaniro azocibwa akorokere hasi.
Nzosenyurira hasi inzu yo mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi hamwe n’inzu yo mu gihe c’ubushuhe; amazu asharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu azosamburwa n’inyubakwa zagutse zizosamburirwa hasi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimwumve iri jambo, yemwe mwa nka z’i Bashani ku Musozi Samariya, yemwe bagore muhahaza aboro mu gahonyora ku gakanu umukene, maze mukabwira abagabo banyu muti: “Nimutuzanire ivyo kunywa bindi!”
Uhoraho Nyeninganji arahiye ukwera kwiwe ati: “Ni ukuri umusi uzoshika aho muzojanwa mukwegeshwa igera, gushika ku wa nyuma muzokwegeshwa amagera nk’ifi.
Umwe wese azosohokanwa bamucishije mu gitoboro baciye mu gihome, maze muzojugunywa mu gihugu c’i Harumoni,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nimuje i Beteli mukore ivyaha; hanyuma muje i Gilugali murushirize. Muzane ibimazi vyanyu uko bukeye, n’ibigiracumi vyanyu uko imyaka itatu iheze.

Nimwotse imikate irimwo umwambiro ibe ishikanwa ryo gushima muvuze inzamba mumenyesha ibimazi mutanze mwishakiye, muvyirate, yemwe Bisirayeli, kuko ari vyo mukunda gukora,” ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
“Abo mu bisagara bimwe nabateje inzara abo mu bindi bose ndabima indya, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nabimye n’imvura hagisigaye amezi atatu ngo iyimbura rigere. Narungitse imvura ku gisagara kimwe, ariko ikindi ndakiyima. Umurima umwe waronse imvura; uwundi ntiwaronka na mba uragaduka.
Abantu bayerera bava mu gisagara baja mu kindi barondera amazi ariko ntibaronka ayabamara inyota, ariko naho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Ni kenshi nakubise imirima y’ingano zanyu n’imizabibu yanyu, ndabiteza kubora no kwuma. Inzige zarishije imisukoni yanyu n’imyelayo yanyu, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Narungitse ibiza muri mwebwe nk’uko nabigiriye Egiputa. Nicishije inkota abahungu banyu, n’amafarasi yanyu aranyagwa. Nujuje mu mazuru yanyu umunuko uva mu bapfiriye mu nsago zanyu, ariko naho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Natembagaje bamwe bo muri mwebwe nk’uko natembagaje Sodomu na Gomora. Abo muri mwebwe barokotse, kwari kurya kw’urukwi rwokowe mu muriro, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“None rero uku ni ko ngiye kukugirira, yewe Isirayeli, kandi kubera nzokugirira gutyo, ga Isirayeli, niwitegure guhura n’Imana yawe.”
Uwabumvye imisozi, uwaremye umuyaga, agahishurira ivyo yiyumvira abana b’abantu, uwuhindura umutwenzi ukaba umwijima, akagendera ku dutwe tw’isi, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Umviriza iri jambo, yewe Isirayeli, iyi ndirimbo yo gucura intimba yerekeye wewe:
“Umukobwa ari we Isirayeli aratemvye, ntazosubira kuvyuka, bamuhebeye mu gihugu ciwe, kandi nta muntu n’umwe wo kumuvyura.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye Isirayeli: “Igisagara cawe cahora kirungika ingabo z’abahizi igihumbi kizosigarana ijana gusa; igisagara cawe cahora kirungika ingabo z’abahizi ijana kizosigarana icumi gusa.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho abwira Abisirayeli: “Nimundondere kugira ngo mubone kubaho;
ntimuronderere i Beteli, ntimuje n’i Gilugali, ntimufate urugendo muja i Berisheba. Kuko i Gilugali bazojanwa ari inyagano mu mahanga, kandi n’i Beteli hazohindurwa hasigare ari ubusa.”
Nimurondere Uhoraho kugira ngo mubeho, atari uko, azotongora imiryango ya Yosefu nk’umuriro; umuriro uzobarigata, kandi i Beteli ntihazoboneka n’umwe wo kuwuzimya.
Hari abahindura ubutungane umururazi bagaterera hasi ubugororotsi.
Uwaremye inyenyeri, Peleyiyade na Oriyoni, agahindura umwijima ukaba umutwenzi kandi agatuma umurango uhinduka ijoro, uwuhamagara amazi yo mu kiyaga akayasuka kw’isi, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Mu kubanguka nk’umuravyo arandura umunyenkomezi igisagara gikomeye akagihindura umusaka.
Hari abanka uwushigikira ubutungane mu manza, bakanka n’uwuvugisha ukuri.
Mucinyiza abakene mukabaka itagisi ku ngano. Ni co gituma, naho mwubatse inzu z’amabuye, mutazozibamwo; naho mwarimye imizabibu myiza, mutazonywa umuvinyu wazo.
Kuko nzi ko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyinshi n’ibicumuro vyanyu bikaba ibihambaye. Hari abacinyiza abatagira icaha hanyuma bakarya ibiturire, bakarenganya abakene mu manza.
Ni co gituma umunyabwenge yinumira mu bihe nk’ibi, kuko ari ibihe bibi.
Nimurondere ivyiza, aho kurondera ibibi, kugira ngo mubeho. Maze Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose azobana namwe, nk’uko mubivuga ko abana namwe.
Nimwanke ibibi, mukunde ivyiza; muce imanza zibereye mu bucamanza. Kumbure Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose yogirira imbabazi amasigarira y’aba Yosefu.

Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze: “Bazoborogera mu mabarabara yose, bavuze induru kubera umubabaro mw’ihuriro ryose ry’abantu. Abarimyi bazohamagarirwa kurira, n’abagandaye ngo baboroge.
Hazoba amaborogo mu mizabibu yose, kuko nzoca hagati muri mwebwe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Muragowe mwebwe mwipfuza umusi w’ Uhoraho ko woshika! Mbega ni kuki mwipfuza umusi w’ Uhoraho ? Uwo musi uzoba uw’umwijima, ntuzoba uw’umuco.
Bizoba nk’uko umuntu yoba ahunze intambwe, maze agaca ahura n’idubu, nk’aho yoba yinjiye mu nzu iwe, akishimikiza igihome, maze inzoka igaca imukomora.
Mbega umusi w’ Uhoraho ntuzoba uw’umwijima, aho kuba uw’umuco; umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, utagiramwo umuco na mukeya?
“Ndanka urunuka, nkongera ngasesemwa n’imisi mikuru yanyu; amakoraniro yanyu y’uburyarya sinzovyihanganira.
Naho mwotanga ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro n’amashikanwa y’ifu, sinzovyakira. Naho mwozana ibimazi vy’ishimwe vy’indobanurwa, sinzobinezererwa.
Nimujane kure urwo rwamo rw’indirimbo zanyu! Sinzokwumviriza inanga zanyu.
Ariko nimureke imanza zibereye zitembe nk’uruzi, ukugororoka kumere nk’umugezi udakama!
Hari ibimazi n’amashikanwa mwanshikaniye mu myaka mirongo ine mwamaze mu bugaragwa, yemwe Bisirayeli?
Mwareruye ibigirwamana mwibumbiye, kimwe ca Sakuti, mwita umwami wanyu n’imana yanyu, n’ica Kewani, inyenyeri yanyu n’imana yanyu.
Ni co gituma nzobirukana muhungire hirya ya Damasiko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, izina ryiwe ni Imana Mushoboravyose.

headings.text: Gucura intimba no guhamagara abantu ngo bihane

verses.text: Muragowe mwebwe abidibamiye i Siyoni, na mwebwe mwumva mutekaniwe ku musozi w’i Samariya, mwebwe abaganwa b’ihanga riruta ayandi, mwebwe abo Abisirayeli baja kwitura!

Nimugende mwirabire i Kalune; muvuyeyo muje i Hamati-Raba igisagara gihambaye, hanyuma mumanuke i Gati mu Bafilisitiya. Mbega ivyo bisagara hari ico birusha ubwami bwanyu uko ari bubiri? Mbega igihugu cabo kiraruta icanyu?
Mwanka kwemera ko umusi w’ivyago ushitse ariko ibikorwa vyanyu bituma umusi w’urubanza ubegera kurusha.
Muryama ku buriri busharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu mukiseguza imisego myiza. Mukirira inyama zoroshe z’imyagazi y’intama n’inka zinuze.
Mwigenera indirimbo nka Dawidi mukazicuraranga ku nanga zanyu.
Munywera umuvinyu mu bikombe bisesekaye mukisiga ibimota neza, bihinguwe rwose, ariko ntimubabazwa n’umusaka wa Yosefu.
Ni co gituma muzoba mu ba mbere mu bazojanwa ari inyagano; imisi mikuru yanyu n’ukwinezereza kwanyu bizoshira.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji ararahiye, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze ati: “Ndanka ubwibone bwa Yakobo kandi nanka n’ingoro ziwe zikomeye; nzotanga iki gisagara n’ibiri muri co vyose.”
Abantu cumi nibasigara mu nzu imwe, na bo nyene bazopfa.

Kandi incuti yabo izoza gusohora imivyimba ngo ituririrwe hanze izobaza uwuzoba yinyegeje ngaho iti: “Mbega hari uwundi muri kumwe?” Maze na we azomwishura agomba kurahira izina ry’Imana ati: “Oya na mba!” Azoca amwamira amubwire ati: “Reka, si umwanya wo gucisha mu kanwa izina ry’ Uhoraho .”
Kuko Uhoraho yabitegetse, kandi azosangangura inzu nini ayigire ubunywenywe, n’inzu ntoya ayigire nk’utuvunguka.
Mbega ifarasi iriruka ku rutare? Hari uwurimisha inka ku kiyaga? Ariko mwahinduye ubutungane ubumara n’icamwa co kugororoka mwagihinduye umururazi,
yemwe abanezerezwa n’uko i Lo Debari hafashwe mukavuga muti: “Mbega ntitwafatishije i Karunayimu inkomezi zacu?”
Kuko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze ati: “Nzohagurutsa ihanga rizoza kugutera, yewe Isirayeli, kandi rizokubabaza urugendo rwose kuva i Lebo-Hamati gushika mu kiyaya c’i Araba.”

headings.text: Uko Uhoraho yanka ubwibone bwa Isirayeli

verses.text: Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: yariko arategura kurungika igitero c’inzige mu gihugu. Ivyo vyabaye, inyuma y’uko umwami amaze kuronka umugabane wiwe w’umwimbu, imirima yo hanyuma iriko iratangura kwera.
Izo nzige zimaze kurya igiterwa cose gitotahaye, ndasemerera nti: “ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, girira imbabazi abantu bawe! Mbega Yakobo yokira gute? Erega ni inkehwa!”
Maze Uhoraho arigarura. Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Ivyo, ntibizoshika.”
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: Uhoraho Nyeninganji yagomba gukoresha umuriro kugira ngo ahane abantu biwe. Umuriro wakamije amazi y’i kuzimu, uturira n’igihugu cose.
Maze ndasemerera nti: “Yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ndakwinginze, geza aho! Mbega Yakobo yokira gute? Erega ni inkehwa!”
Maze Uhoraho arigarura. Uhoraho Nyeninganji aravuga ati: “N’ibi na vyo ntibizoshika.”
Ibi ni vyo yanyeretse: Imana yari ihagaze i ruhande y’uruhome rwubatswe hakoreshejwe igipimo karisho, cerekena ukugororoka kw’uruhome, kandi na yo yari ifise uwo mugozi n’ico gipimo mu kuboko kwayo.

Maze Imana irambaza iti: “Ubona iki ga Amosi?” Ndishura nti: “Mbona umugozi uriko karisho.” Maze Uhoraho aravuga ati: Raba, ndiko ndapimisha karisho abantu banje b’Abisirayeli; sinzosubira kubaziguriza na mba.
“Ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi vya Isaka bizosamburwa kandi n’ibigabiro vya Isirayeli bizohinduka umusaka; nzoramvura inkota yanje ngwanye abo mu nda y’ingoma ya Yerobowamu.”

Maze Amaziya umuherezi w’i Beteli arungikira ubutumwa Yerobowamu umwami w’Abisirayeli ati: “Amosi ariko ategura abantu bo kukugwanya, kandi bari aha hagati mu Bisirayeli. Igihugu ntigishobora kubandanya cihanganira amajambo yiwe.
Kuko uku ari ko Amosi avuga, ngo: ‘Yerobowamu azokwicwa n’inkota, kandi Abisirayeli nta kabuza bazojanwa ari inyagano, kure y’igihugu cabo c’amavukiro.’ ”
Nuko Amaziya abwira Amosi ati: “Sohoka, yewe kamenyi! Subira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda. Wironkereyo ibigutunga kandi uvugishirizweyo.
Ntusubire kuvugishirizwa i Beteli, kuko aha ni urusengero rw’umwami n’ingoro y’ubwami.”
Amosi yishura Amaziya ati: “Sinigeze mba umuvugishwa canke ngo mbe n’umwana w’umuvugishwa, ahubwo nari umwungere kandi narima imisukomora.
Ariko Uhoraho yankuye inyuma y’imikuku arambwira ati: ‘Genda, uvugishwe ku bantu banje b’Abisirayeli.’
Nuko rero, niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho . Uvuze uti: ‘Ntuvugishwe ku Bisirayeli, kandi uhagarike kuburira bene Isaka.’

Ku bw’ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Umugore wawe azoba maraya mu gisagara, kandi abahungu bawe n’abakobwa bawe bazokwicwa n’inkota. Igihugu cawe kizogabuzwa umugozi kigaburwemwo ibice, kandi wewe ubwawe uzopfira mu gihugu c’abanyamahanga. Kandi Abisirayeli nta kabuza bazojanwa ari inyagano, kure y’igihugu cabo c’amavukiro.’ ”
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: nabonye igiseke c’ivyamwa vyeze.
Arambaza ati: “Ubona iki, ga Amosi?” Ndishura nti: “Igiseke c’ivyamwa vyeze.” Maze Uhoraho ambwira ati: “Igihe kirageze, c’uko abantu banje b’Abisirayeli basoromwa, sinzosubira kubaziguriza.
Kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, “indirimbo zo mu rusengero zizohinduka amaborogo. Imivyimba myinshi, myinshi cane, izotabwa ahantu hose! Nimucereze!”
Nimwumve ibi, mwebwe munyaga aboro mugasiribanga abakene,

mukavuga muti: “Mbega imboneko z’ukwezi zizogera ryari kugira ngo dusubire kwidandariza ingano; Isabato izohera ryari ngo dusubire kwigurishiriza ingano?” Aho rero mukoresha ingero z’ibinyoma, mukaduza ibiciro uko mwishakiye kandi mukiba mukoresheje iminzane y’ibinyoma.
Mugura umukene ifeza, n’umworo mukamugura umwambaro umwe w’ibirato, mukagurisha n’ingano mwavanze n’ibikumbi.
Uhoraho ararahiye, uwo Yakobo yishimira ati: “Sinzokwigera nibagira na kimwe mu vyo bakoze.
Mbega igihugu ntikizohinda agashitsi kubera ivyo, ababa muri co na bo ntibazogandara? Igihugu cose kizohaguruka nk’uruzi Nili; kizoduga hejuru maze gihwame nka rwa ruzi rwa Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, “Nzotuma izuba rirenga ku murango, bwire kw’isi mu gihe c’amashoka.

Nzohindura imisi mikuru yanyu ibe ibihe vyo kugandara n’imvyino zanyu zose ndazihindure amarira. Nzotuma mwese mwambara amagunira mwimoshe inkomvorera. Ico gihe nzokigira ico kuboroga nk’uwuborogera umwana wiwe w’ikinege kandi umusi wo kuganduka uzoba uw’umururazi.
Imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, “aho nzorungika inzara mu gihugu; ntizoba ari inzara y’ivyokurya canke inyota y’amazi, ariko izoba ari inzara yo kwumva amajambo y’ Uhoraho .
Abantu bazokubita ku kiyaga baje ku kindi, bave mu buraruko baje mu buseruko, barondera ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , ariko ntibazoribona.
Kuri uwo musi, inkumi nzizanziza n’abasore bezabeza bazorabikwa n’inyota.

Abirahira ibigirwamana biteye isoni vy’i Samariya, abavuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kw’imana yawe, Dani,’ canke ngo: ‘Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kw’imana y’i Berisheba,’ abo bose bazotemba, kandi ntibazokwongera kuvyuka.”

Nabonye Imana ihagaze i ruhande y’igicaniro, hanyuma ivuga ati: “Kubita ubushorishori bw’inkingi z’urusengero, kugeza amatanguriro yazo anyiganyize. Zisenyurire hasi maze zigwe ku mitwe y’ubu bwoko; abazoba basigaye nzobicisha inkota. Nta n’umwe azohunga, nta n’umwe azosigara.
Naho bokwimba gushika i kuzimu, ukuboko kwanje kuzobakurayo. Naho boduga bakaja mw’ijuru hejuru, nzobamanurayo.
Naho bokwihisha ku gatwe ka Karumeli, nzobahiga ndabafate ndabamanureyo. Naho bokwinyegeza inyonga zanje i bwina mu kiyaga, nzotuma inzoka ibakomorereyo.
Naho bojanwa nk’inyagano n’abansi babo, nzotegeka inkota ibasogotereyo. Igitsure canje kizoguma kuri bo kugira ngo ndabagirire nabi, si ukubagirira neza.”
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, akoze kw’isi ica irashonga, kandi ababa muri yo bose baragandaye; igihugu cose gihagurutse nk’uruzi Nili, hanyuma kirahwama nk’urwo ruzi rwa Egiputa.
Uhoraho yubatse ikirimba ciwe iyo mw’ijuru hejuru ashira amatanguriro yaco kw’isi; ahamagara amazi yo mu kiyaga akayasuka kw’isi, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe.

“Mbega mwebwe Abisirayeli ntimumeze nk’Abanyakushi kuri jewe?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Mbega sinaduganye Abisirayeli ndabakuye muri Egiputa, Abafilisitiya nkabakura i Kafutori Abasiriya na bo nkabakura muri Kiru?
“Ni ukuri inyonga z’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji ziri ku bwami bucumura. Nzobusambura ndabuherengeteze kw’isi. Ariko sinzoherengeteza rwose abakomoka kuri Yakobo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Kuko nzotanga itegeko, maze ntume Abisirayeli bahinda agashitsi hagati y’ayandi mahanga nk’uko ingano zigosorerwa ku rutaro, kandi ntihagire n’agatete kamwe gakorokera hasi.
Abanyavyaha bo mu bantu banje bazokwicwa n’inkota, abo bose bavuga bati: ‘Ivyago ntibizodushikira canke ngo duhure na vyo.’
Kuri uwo musi, nzovyura ihema rya Dawidi ryaguye hasi, nzosanura impome zaryo zabomotse, nsanure n’imisaka yaho; kandi nzosubira kuryubaka rimere nk’uko ryahora,
kugira ngo begukire amasigarira ya Edomu n’amahanga yose yitirirwa izina ryanje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ari we nyene azobishitsa.

“Imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho umwimbuzi azokurikirana n’umubivyi, n’uwutera imbuto agakurikirana n’uwudandaza imizabibu. Umutobe musha w’umuvinyu uzotemba ku misozi, kandi n’uturambi twose tuzorengerwa n’umuvinyu,

kandi nzogarukana abantu banje b’Abisirayeli ndabavanye mu kinyago. Bazosubira bubake ibisagara vyahindutse imisaka babibemwo. Bazotera imizabibu banywe umuvinyu wayo; bazotera ibiti barye ivyamwa vyavyo.
Nzotera Abisirayeli mu gihugu cabo, kandi sinzosubira kubarandura, ngo ndabakure mu gihugu nabahaye,” ni ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu avuze.
